name: Bloomtail Minnow
tooltip:
Bloomtail Minnow
5 yd range
3.2 sec cast
Anglin' Score:  points.

Catch Rank: Guppy

Description:
Its truly unique tail fin resembles that of a flower in bloom. The light emitting from its tail dulls in motion and illuminates when stagnant. Its small size and tendency to travel in schools add a fluorescent motion to the depths of the Harandar.

Special:

Fresh Fillet

Salvaging this fish with the Cooking skill will produce Fresh Fillet.

Areas you can find this fish:
- Harandar

Fishing Pools:
- Lashing Waves

Rates:
- This fish is exceedingly common in pools.

Discovery: Fishing
